lede: A free 5 km morning run in Gulshan, built around movement, connection and consistency. Sign-up is essential and spots are limited.
body:
"আমরা কিন্তু যাচ্ছি দৌড়াতে" — we're going running. [@the.dowrunclub](https://www.instagram.com/the.dowrunclub/) is hosting a free **5K community run in Gulshan**, presented by [@batabangladesh](https://www.instagram.com/batabangladesh/), and B-POP Tags is lacing up.

## 5K community run in Gulshan: the details

- **Where:** Shahabuddin Park, Gulshan, Dhaka
- **Start time:** 6:00 AM
- **Distance:** 5 km
- **Cost:** free registration
- **Spots:** limited, and sign-up is essential

The post's hashtags include #fridaymorning, but it doesn't give a calendar date, so check the sign-up form before you set your alarm.

Quick checklist before race morning:

- Register through the form linked below, since sign-up is essential
- Plan to reach Shahabuddin Park before the 6:00 AM start
- Bring friends: the run is open to runners, creators, students and professionals alike

## More than a morning workout

The organisers describe it as "a morning built around movement, connection, and consistency." They're bringing together runners, creators, students and professionals who believe "the best communities are built one run at a time."

The cover leans into the city theme. "The Dow Run Club" and "City Run" sit in pixel-style type over a blurred, acid-green image of a runner with one arm raised, under a location pin for Shahabuddin Park, Gulshan.

## How to register for the run

Registration is free but required. Sign up through the [Dow Run Club registration form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdy1Z1XBW3wwYPDzlWeVLQO6cCgVfnjcObvdgQiqzxI7mOl4A/viewform?pli=1), and do it early, since the caption says spots are limited. Then, in the post's own words: come run, connect, and be part of the community. See you at the start line.

## Why community runs matter

Not every gathering in the city needs a sound system. Morning runs like this one build the same thing a good party does: a crew of regulars who keep showing up for each other. The Dow Run Club's focus on consistency, one run at a time, is a reminder that community is something you practise. For more community-built events, see [Productive Chill, networking for people who don't like networking](post:productive-chill-networking-dhaka), the [Open to All art exhibition at Alliance Française de Dhaka](post:alliance-francaise-dhaka-open-art-exhibition) and our [September events list](post:dhaka-events-to-save-september-2026).
